title: George Lewis, Chris Kelly's band and Buddy's later band
summary: Zardis knew George Lewis but he was not there then; after Buddy's band faded he played with Chris Kelly, Kid Rena and Jack Carey, while George played with Buddy.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Um, well, um, now, can you remember George Lewis at that time?

George, I've been knowing George all my days. But George, like, uh, he wasn't over there at the time. We were over there, you know what I mean? But I've been knowing George. I used to play with George's band. We had a band with Chris Kelly. And, uh, the rest of the guys there, it was, I can't think all, all the fellas that, uh, we had at that time, you know. But I know Chris Kelly was waiting with us and the same, uh, Jim Robison. Jim Robison was working with us too in that band, you know. And, uh, we did good around here. We did nice. We had a nice band with Chris Kelly. Mm-hmm.
Now that was late then, wasn't it? That would have been later. That would have been after. That would have been after, say, in the mid-20s or something.

No, that wasn't that, uh, it wasn't quite the mid-20s. It was, uh, well, right after we left for our bodies. Yeah, around, oh, I think around, uh, I don't know, I just can't remember. Just, uh, the day so long, you know what I mean? The year. Mm-hmm. But I know Buddy stayed over there quite a while. And after we left them over there, that's when we came back here. And that's where we left for, you know, or this boy just sent for a hall to come up there. Well, after that time, my Buddy band was kind of going to pieces, you know? Mm-hmm. Well, I was playing with Kid Rene band, and I was playing with Jack Carey band, and, you know, Chris Kelly band. Well, just whatever band had to work, that's the band I'd work with, you know what I mean? Because sometimes I'd get messed up on my dates, well, I'd just go tell them, say, well, I've been taking the date for some such, you know, day, and that was it, you know what I mean? Mm-hmm. So, uh, it got to be all right like that.
Well, now, isn't it, isn't it the fact that George replaced, um, Edmund Hall when Edmund Hall left?

In Buddy band? Mm-hmm. Yeah, George played a while with Buddy band, see, but I was, I had left Buddy band, then I was working with Chris Kelly band, Ed Rene band, like I told you, and Jack Carey's band, you know? Yes. But George, he was still running around there with Buddy.
Yes, because I know that George was, he moved over there, his father was living over there or something, and he used to spend some time there in Madison.
Yes, yes, I remember that too, yes, that's right.
